name: ambiguous fraction explanation with the topic's material

input.prompt: Explain why 2/4 and 1/2 are the same amount.
input.key: Rubric: both are one half; multiplying the top and bottom of 1/2 by 2 gives 2/4.
input.response: if you split each half into 2 you get 2 quarters, its the same bit of the pizza

grounding.idea: Multiplying the top and bottom by the same number gives an equal fraction.

doubts: The first grader was only 70% confident.

misconceptions.belief: Bigger numbers on top and bottom mean a bigger fraction.
